latest_release.name: v0.8.1
latest_release.body:
# 🚀 Zvec v0.8.1 Release Notes

## 📦 New Features
+ **PQ for HNSW and IVF:** Added PQ4/PQ8 and optional OPQ, covering training, search, persistence, and subsequent updates. ([#833](https://github.com/alibaba/zvec/pull/833))
+ **Broader platform support:** Enabled RaBitQ on Linux, macOS, Android, and iOS ARM64, plus Intel Mac. DiskANN now supports Intel Mac and Windows ARM64. ([#832](https://github.com/alibaba/zvec/pull/832), [#874](https://github.com/alibaba/zvec/pull/874))
+ **Grouped search in the C API:** Added grouped vector query and result-management APIs. ([#845](https://github.com/alibaba/zvec/pull/845))

## 🚀 Performance Improvements
+ **Lower build memory:** Reduced vector copying and temporary storage in DiskANN, IVF, and selected HNSW construction paths. ([#853](https://github.com/alibaba/zvec/pull/853), [#877](https://github.com/alibaba/zvec/pull/877), [#879](https://github.com/alibaba/zvec/pull/879), [#880](https://github.com/alibaba/zvec/pull/880))
+ **Faster search and construction:** Improved Flat batch queries, HNSW construction, and FP16 distance calculation, and completed ARM NEON batch-distance kernels. ([#862](https://github.com/alibaba/zvec/pull/862), [#871](https://github.com/alibaba/zvec/pull/871), [#856](https://github.com/alibaba/zvec/pull/856))

## 🐞 Key Fixes
+ Strengthened read-only storage guarantees, fixing index modifications on read-only close, WAL recovery boundaries, and writable reopen behavior. ([#834](https://github.com/alibaba/zvec/pull/834), [#840](https://github.com/alibaba/zvec/pull/840), [#870](https://github.com/alibaba/zvec/pull/870))
+ Fixed HNSW RaBitQ scoring, missing external-vector handling, crashes after failed schema changes, and collection locks retained through inherited file descriptors. ([#851](https://github.com/alibaba/zvec/pull/851), [#861](https://github.com/alibaba/zvec/pull/861), [#822](https://github.com/alibaba/zvec/pull/822), [#859](https://github.com/alibaba/zvec/pull/859))

**Upgrade note:** Collections with pending WAL recovery must first be opened and closed in writable mode before being opened read-only. ([#840](https://github.com/alibaba/zvec/pull/840))

Thanks to all contributors, and welcome to first-time contributors [@ZoruaSama](https://github.com/ZoruaSama) and [@ilike314272](https://github.com/ilike314272)!

**Full Changelog:**[v0.8.0...v0.8.1](https://github.com/alibaba/zvec/compare/v0.8.0...v0.8.1)

English | 中文

🚀 Quickstart | 🏠 Home | 📚 Docs | 📊 Benchmarks | 🔎 DeepWiki | 🎮 Discord | 🐦 X (Twitter)

**Zvec** is an open-source, in-process vector database — lightweight, lightning-fast, and designed to embed directly into applications. Battle-tested within Alibaba Group, it delivers production-grade, low-latency and scalable similarity search with minimal setup. > [!Important] > 🚀 **v0.8.0** > > - **Broader platform support**: Added **Intel Mac** and **Windows ARM64** builds, wheels, and SDKs; extended **DiskANN to Windows, Android, and iOS**, and **RaBitQ to Windows x86_64**. > - **Chinese FTS ready to use**: Embedded the default **Jieba dictionary and HMM model**, so Chinese tokenization needs no separate dictionary files or path configuration. > - **Lower index build costs**: Reduced peak memory during **IVF / DiskANN** builds and merges, and accelerated **HNSW RaBitQ** construction through vector reuse and batched lookups. Build and nested training tasks now enforce configured thread limits more strictly. > - **Faster distance computation**: Extensively refactored quantizers and distance calculations to benefit multiple quantization types and metrics, with major improvements to **INT4 kernels** and **Linux ARM64** performance. > - **Faster search**: Added faster **Uniform quantizers** and optimized **Vamana** graph layout and prefetching. Uniform quantization avoids per-point score reconstruction, though a shared min/max range can increase quantization error and reduce recall. > - **Bug fixes and improvements**: Added more flexible **UTF-8 document IDs** up to 1,024 bytes; fixed concurrent reads during segment switches, index rebuilding with deleted rows, and correctness issues in **LIKE** and floating-point range filters. > > 👉 [Read the Release Notes](https://github.com/alibaba/zvec/releases/tag/v0.8.0) [^query-performance]: Measured on GIST 1M with L2 distance, INT8 quantization, and HNSW on a 16-core Linux ARM64 system. ## 💫 Features - **Blazing Fast**: Searches billions of vectors in milliseconds. - **Simple, Just Works**: [Install](#-installation) and start searching in seconds. Pure local, no servers, no config, no fuss. - **Dense + Sparse Vectors**: Support dense and sparse embeddings, multi-vector queries, and a rich selection of [vector index types](https://zvec.org/en/docs/db/concepts/vector-index/#vector-index-types) that scale from memory to disk. - **Full-Text Search (FTS)**: Native keyword-based full-text search — query string fields with natural-language or structured expressions. - **Hybrid Search**: Fuse vector similarity, full-text search, and structured filters in a single query for precise results. - **Durable Storage**: Write-ahead logging (WAL) guarantees persistence — data is never lost, even on process crash or power failure. - **Concurrent Access**: Multiple processes can read the same collection simultaneously; writes are single-process exclusive. - **Runs Anywhere**: As an in-process library, Zvec runs wherever your code runs — notebooks, servers, CLI tools, or even edge devices. ## 📦 Installation Zvec offers official SDKs across multiple languages: | SDK | Install / Dependency | Source | | --- | --- | --- | | [Python](https://pypi.org/project/zvec/) | `pip install zvec` | [Source](https://github.com/alibaba/zvec/tree/main/python/zvec) | | [Node.js](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zvec/zvec) | `npm install @zvec/zvec` | [Source](https://github.com/zvec-ai/zvec-node) | | [Go](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/zvec-ai/zvec-go) | [Installation guide](https://github.com/zvec-ai/zvec-go#installation) | [Source](https://github.com/zvec-ai/zvec-go) | | [Rust](https://crates.io/crates/zvec-rust) | `cargo add zvec-rust` | [Source](https://github.com/zvec-ai/zvec-rust) | | [Java](https://central.sonatype.com/artifact/org.zvec/zvec-java) | `org.zvec:zvec-java` (Maven) | [Source](https://github.com/zvec-ai/zvec-java) | | [Dart / Flutter](https://pub.dev/packages/zvec) | `flutter pub add zvec` | [Source](https://github.com/zvec-ai/zvec-dart) | Python requires 64-bit Python 3.10–3.14; Java requires Java 8+. Searching code or documents? Try **[zvec-grep](https://github.com/zvec-ai/zvec-grep)** (`zg`) — a local-first search CLI that unifies ripgrep, BM25, and vector search, built for humans and AI agents. Prefer a visual tool? Try **[Zvec Studio](https://github.com/zvec-ai/zvec-studio)** to browse data and debug queries — no code required. ### ✅ Cross-Platform Support **Linux · macOS · Windows · Android · iOS** Zvec supports all major platforms — from servers and desktops to mobile devices.
For more details, please see the [platform support documentation](https://zvec.org/en/docs/db/platforms/). ### 🛠️ Building from Source If you prefer to build Zvec from source, please check the [Building from Source](https://zvec.org/en/docs/db/build/) guide. ## ⚡ One-Minute Python Example ```python import zvec # Define collection schema schema = zvec.CollectionSchema( name="example", vectors=zvec.VectorSchema("embedding", zvec.DataType.VECTOR_FP32, 4), ) # Create collection collection = zvec.create_and_open(path="./zvec_example", schema=schema) # Insert documents collection.insert([ zvec.Doc(id="doc_1", vectors={"embedding": [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4]}), zvec.Doc(id="doc_2", vectors={"embedding": [0.2, 0.3, 0.4, 0.1]}), ]) # Search by vector similarity results = collection.query( zvec.Query(field_name="embedding", vector=[0.4, 0.3, 0.3, 0.1]), topk=10 ) # Results: list of {'id': str, 'score': float, ...}, sorted by relevance print(results) ``` ## 📈 Performance at Scale Zvec delivers exceptional speed and efficiency, making it ideal for demanding production workloads. For detailed benchmark methodology, configurations, and complete results, please see our [Benchmarks documentation](https://zvec.org/en/docs/db/benchmarks/). ## 🤝 Join Our Community
| 💬 DingTalk | 📱 WeChat | 🎮 Discord | X (Twitter) | | :---: | :---: | :---: | :---: | | | | [![Discord](https://img.shields.io/badge/Discord-Join%20Server-5865F2?style=for-the-badge&logo=discord&logoColor=white)](https://discord.gg/rKddFBBu9z) | [![X (formerly Twitter) Follow](https://img.shields.io/twitter/follow/ZvecAI)]() | | Scan to join | Scan to join | Click to join | Click to follow |
## ❤️ Contributing We welcome and appreciate contributions from the community! Whether you're fixing a bug, adding a feature, or improving documentation, your help makes Zvec better for everyone. Check out our [Contributing Guide](./CONTRIBUTING.md) to get started!

🚀 快速开始 | 🏠 主页 | 📚 文档 | 📊 性能报告 | 🔎 DeepWiki | 🎮 Discord | 🐦 X (Twitter)

**Zvec** 是一款开源的嵌入式(进程内)向量数据库 — 轻量、极速，可直接嵌入应用程序。以极简的配置提供生产级、低延迟、可扩展的向量检索能力。 > [!IMPORTANT] > 🚀 **v0.8.0** > > - **平台覆盖更广**：新增 **Intel Mac、Windows ARM64** 构建、wheel 与 SDK， **DiskANN 扩展至 Windows、Android 和 iOS**， **RaBitQ 新增 Windows x86_64 支持**。 > - **中文全文检索开箱即用**：内置 **Jieba 中文词典和 HMM 模型**，无需单独部署词典文件或配置词典路径。 > - **建图更省内存、更快**：降低 **IVF / DiskANN** 建图与合并时的峰值内存，通过向量复用与批量查找加速 **HNSW RaBitQ** 建图；建图与嵌套训练更严格地遵守配置的线程数限制。 > - **距离计算全面提速**：大范围重构量化器和距离计算，多种量化类型与距离度量均受益， **INT4 内核**和 **Linux ARM64** 场景下尤为明显。 > - **更快的检索**：新增更快的 **Uniform 系列量化器**，优化 **Vamana** 图布局与预取。Uniform 量化避免逐点分数反算，但共享 Min/Max 可能增大量化误差、降低召回率。 > - **修复与改进**：支持更灵活的 **UTF-8 文档 ID**，长度上限提升至 1,024 字节；修复分段切换时的并发读取、含删除记录的索引重建，以及 **LIKE、浮点范围过滤**等正确性问题。 > > 👉 [查看更新日志](https://github.com/alibaba/zvec/releases/tag/v0.8.0) ## 💫 核心特性 - **极致性能**：毫秒级响应，轻松检索数十亿级向量。 - **开箱即用**：[安装](#-安装)后即刻开始搜索，纯本地运行，无需服务器、无需配置、零门槛。 - **稠密 + 稀疏向量**：支持稠密向量、稀疏向量与多向量查询，以及从内存到磁盘、丰富多样的[向量索引类型](https://zvec.org/zh/docs/db/concepts/vector-index/#向量索引类型)。 - **全文检索（FTS）**：原生的基于关键词的全文检索——使用自然语言或结构化表达式检索字符串字段。 - **混合检索**：在单次查询中融合向量语义、全文检索与标量过滤，获得精确结果。 - **持久化存储**：WAL 预写日志保障数据持久性 — 即使进程崩溃或意外断电，数据也不会丢失。 - **并发访问**：支持多进程同时读取同一个 Collection；写入为单进程独占模式。 - **进程内运行**：无需单独部署服务，纯进程内运行。Notebook、高性能服务器、CLI 工具、边缘设备 — 随处可用。 ## 📦 安装 Zvec 提供多语言官方 SDK： | SDK | 安装 / 依赖 | 源码 | | --- | --- | --- | | [Python](https://pypi.org/project/zvec/) | `pip install zvec` | [源码](https://github.com/alibaba/zvec/tree/main/python/zvec) | | [Node.js](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@zvec/zvec) | `npm install @zvec/zvec` | [源码](https://github.com/zvec-ai/zvec-node) | | [Go](https://pkg.go.dev/github.com/zvec-ai/zvec-go) | [安装指南](https://github.com/zvec-ai/zvec-go/blob/main/README_CN.md#安装) | [源码](https://github.com/zvec-ai/zvec-go) | | [Rust](https://crates.io/crates/zvec-rust) | `cargo add zvec-rust` | [源码](https://github.com/zvec-ai/zvec-rust) | | [Java](https://central.sonatype.com/artifact/org.zvec/zvec-java) | `org.zvec:zvec-java`（Maven） | [源码](https://github.com/zvec-ai/zvec-java) | | [Dart / Flutter](https://pub.dev/packages/zvec) | `flutter pub add zvec` | [源码](https://github.com/zvec-ai/zvec-dart) | Python 需 64 位 Python 3.10–3.14；Java 需 Java 8+。 想搜索代码或文档？试试 **[zvec-grep](https://github.com/zvec-ai/zvec-grep)**（`zg`）— 本地优先的搜索 CLI，统一 ripgrep、BM25 与向量检索，为人类与 AI Agent 而设计。 想要图形界面？试试 **[Zvec Studio](https://github.com/zvec-ai/zvec-studio)**，零代码浏览数据与调试查询。 ### ✅ 全平台支持 **Linux · macOS · Windows · Android · iOS** Zvec 提供全平台支持，覆盖服务器、桌面和移动设备。
如需了解更多细节，请查阅[平台支持文档](https://zvec.org/zh/docs/db/platforms/)。 ### 🛠️ 源码构建 如需从源码构建 Zvec，请参考[源码构建指南](https://zvec.org/zh/docs/db/build/)。 ## ⚡ 一分钟上手（Python） ```python import zvec # 定义 collection schema schema = zvec.CollectionSchema( name="example", vectors=zvec.VectorSchema("embedding", zvec.DataType.VECTOR_FP32, 4), ) # 创建 collection collection = zvec.create_and_open(path="./zvec_example", schema=schema) # 插入 documents collection.insert([ zvec.Doc(id="doc_1", vectors={"embedding": [0.1, 0.2, 0.3, 0.4]}), zvec.Doc(id="doc_2", vectors={"embedding": [0.2, 0.3, 0.4, 0.1]}), ]) # 向量相似度检索 results = collection.query( zvec.Query(field_name="embedding", vector=[0.4, 0.3, 0.3, 0.1]), topk=10 ) # 查询结果：按相关性排序的 {'id': str, 'score': float, ...} 列表 print(results) ``` ## 📈 极致性能 Zvec 提供极致的速度和效率，能够轻松应对高要求的生产环境负载。 有关具体的测试方法、配置及完整结果，请参阅[性能报告](https://zvec.org/zh/docs/db/benchmarks/)。 ## 🤝 加入社区
